# ÚÙ Design system (UU DS)

> UU DS design system. 2-tier tokens (primitive → semantic), brand modes for any brand — Default (`:root`: interactive indigo, accent blue, slate neutrals) and UU (`data-theme="uu"`: the orange + yellow Ú Ù identity) built in, density Touch / Compact, layout axis Expanded / Collapsed, hover/pressed through a state layer, 37 decided components, the public UU icon set. The Storybook is for human readers; the files below are the same content in machine-readable form.

Base of every path below: https://uucreative.co/uu-ds/ (e.g. https://uucreative.co/uu-ds/docs/design-system.md). Read in order. Every file is the original, not a summary.

Skill for Claude (same content, with public icons): https://uucreative.co/uu-ds/uu-design-system.zip
Install the skill for local AI agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex…): `npx skills add buiphamthanhtu/uu-ds --skill uu-design-system`
Check web code after writing it (project with the `uu-ds` package): `npx uu-ds-check src` — reports hex, `--color-*`, invented tokens, hover color changes, off-scale px, invented components/icons, other UI libraries. Fix until critical = 0. Add `--strict` to fail CI while criticals remain.

## Must read before writing code

- [Core spec](docs/design-system.md): section 0 (rules), 1–3 (tokens, color, typography), 4 (spacing/radius/elevation, density, layout, DNA), 5 (component list — anything outside it is not decided), 6.0 (state layer), and the table mapping each component to its file.
- Component files `docs/components/<name>.md`, one per component (§6.1–6.32). Read only the files of the components you use. Files: [badge bottom-bar bottom-sheet breadcrumb button-group checkbox chip date-input dialog dropdown icon-button icon kpi-card list-item menu navigation-bar notification-badge otp-input pagination popover push-notification radio screen-templates search-input segmented-control side-nav side-sheet status-indicator switch tab table-pagination table text-area text-button text-input toast toggle-button tooltip ](docs/components/badge bottom-bar bottom-sheet breadcrumb button-group checkbox chip date-input dialog dropdown icon-button icon kpi-card list-item menu navigation-bar notification-badge otp-input pagination popover push-notification radio screen-templates search-input segmented-control side-nav side-sheet status-indicator switch tab table-pagination table text-area text-button text-input toast toggle-button tooltip .md)
- [tokens.css](docs/tokens.css): CSS custom properties, brand modes, state-layer recipe `.uu-interactive .uu-on-dark .uu-on-light`, text styles `.text-*`.

## Product DNA: do it before the first screen

UU DS is the skeleton; the DNA is each product's own character. Look for `DNA.md` in this order: the path the user gives, the project root, `docs/DNA.md`. Not found → ask once: is there a DNA or a style anchor (screenshots, website)? With a style anchor, extract it into `DNA.md`. Without one, build Basic and mention it in one line at handoff.

- [Product DNA](docs/product-dna.md): finding the file, locked vs changeable parts, applying with `[data-theme]`, extracting, checks before handoff.
- [DNA template](docs/dna-template.md): copy to `DNA.md` when extracting.

## When needed

- [tokens.json](docs/tokens.json): DTCG-style, with `$resolved` — generate for iOS/Android/Style Dictionary.
- [tailwind.js](docs/tailwind.js): Tailwind theme pointing at CSS vars — only if the project uses Tailwind.
- [icons.md](docs/icons.md): UU icon rules (one Icon(name, variant, size) component, SVG currentColor, fill = on state, not in the index → ask), adding icons.
- [uu-icon-index.json](docs/uu-icon-index.json): public icon names → category and available styles (outline / fill).
- [ontology.json](docs/ontology.json): the system map (ontology) — tokens, components, modes, color roles, decision trees and relations (usesToken, composedOf, confusedWith, chosenWhen…). Not in the nodes = not decided. Quick summary: [ontology.md](docs/ontology.md).



## Six constraints

1. Never hardcode colors; only semantic tokens `--background-*` `--object-*` `--border-*`; `--color-*` is forbidden in components.
2. Brand is one token layer (22 tokens, spec 2.5), switched with `data-theme` (`default` · `uu`, on `<html>` or a region); components don't know the brand; `accent` ≠ `interactive`.
3. Hover/Pressed = a state layer `::after` painted with the variant's object color (CSS `currentColor`), opacity 5/10 on light backgrounds · 20/40 on dark; no background/text/weight change; Disabled and Loading have none.
4. Only existing scales: gap in 4px steps, radius-*, 11 font sizes, absolute line-heights (web: rem, app: px), density Touch / Compact (`data-density="compact"`, spec §4.1), system font (never embed SF Pro).
5. Only build components in spec section 5; missing → ask; anything improvised must be marked. Not decided: `BottomBar` item Hover/Pressed and position, empty / loading table rows.
6. Icons via Icon(name, variant, size). The 22 UU icons in the package only make components work and fill examples (names in uu-icon-index.json). A product that needs icons attaches one set via DNA (free like Lucide, or Nucleo) with IconProvider; no set yet → ask the user. Never draw icons, never mix single icons from two sets.

## Reference code (public repo github.com/buiphamthanhtu/uu-ds)

The packages are **not published on the npm registry / pub.dev**: install from GitHub as below. Don't run `npm install uu-ds`: that npm name does not belong to UU DS.

- Web (React + plain CSS), branch `web`: `npm i "github:buiphamthanhtu/uu-ds#web-v1.0.0"`. Exports: `.`, `./tokens.css`, `./base.css`, `./icons`, `./icons/svg/*`. Zalo Mini App (ZMP, React) uses this package directly.
  - `src/components/*`, names match the spec: TextButtonAccent, TextButtonNeutral, TextButtonDanger, IconButtonAccent, IconButtonNeutral, ToggleButton, ButtonGroup, TextInput, TextArea, OTPInput, SearchInput, DateInput, Dropdown, Menu, Checkbox, CheckboxInput, Radio, RadioInput, RadioList, Switch, Chip, SegmentedControl, NavigationBar, BottomBar, Tab, TabBar, Pagination, Toast, Badge, StatusIndicator, NotificationBadge, Tooltip, CardSheet, BottomSheet, BaseDialog, Dialog, CardDialog, CardPushNotification, SideSheet, Popover, Table, TableRow, TableHeaderCell, TableCell, TablePagination, KPICard, Breadcrumb, SideNav, SideNavItem, SideNavSection, ListItem, ListGroup, EmptyScreen, EmptySection, ErrorSection, ErrorScreen, ResultScreen, Spinner.
  - `src/icons/Icon.tsx` + `src/icons/svg/<name>[-fill].svg` (public icons × outline/fill, viewBox 0 0 18 18, currentColor).
  - `AGENTS.md` at the root of the `web` branch: instructions for AI coding agents.
- React Native / Expo, branch `native`: `npm i "github:buiphamthanhtu/uu-ds#native-v1.0.0"`. `tokens.g.ts` generated from tokens.json, same scope as Flutter.
- Flutter, branch `main`, folder `packages/flutter/uu_ds_flutter` (declare `git:` in pubspec with that `path`, `ref: flutter-v1.0.0`). `tokens.g.dart` generated from tokens.json; widgets `UuTextButton`, `UuTextInput`, `UuIcon`… with the same props as web.
- Widgetbook (real Flutter widgets, viewable on the web): [widgetbook/](widgetbook/).
- UU Design system Figma file (Figma Community, components and variables per the spec; on conflict the spec wins): https://www.figma.com/community/file/1701990688423474087/uu-design-system
